title: Durunal the Cursebearer
summary: Defeat Durunal while managing repeated lightning elementals and disruptive spells.
overview: Defeat Durunal while managing repeated lightning elementals and disruptive spells.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare for the opening Harm Touch and reserve control for each three-elemental wave.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: An eligible paladin entering the zone can summon Durunal when the two-hour trigger cooldown is clear.
He opens combat with Harm Touch and brings three lightning elementals every two minutes.
Epoch Conviction, Gyrosonic Disruption and Thunder Call recur on separate combat timers.
The encounter has a one-hour cleanup timer from spawn.

notes: Approval E397. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
